name: Essence Harvester resets Vampiric Fang when the Bloodmage is struck low (#1182)
contract: Essence Harvester 806421's single effect is SPELL_AURA_PROC_TRIGGER_SPELL (aura 42) on Wretched 504284, which is complete on its own: aura 23 SPELL_AURA_PERIODIC_TRIGGER_SPELL on 504283 every 1000 ms plus SPELL_EFFECT_ASCENSION_RESET_COOLDOWN (195) with MiscValue 804726 = Vampiric Fang and MiscValueB 1. Spell.dbc gives 806421 ProcFlags 0 and no spell_proc row existed, so SpellMgr::LoadSpellProcs generated no entry, Aura::GetProcEffectMask returned 0 and the aura was inert. The tooltip is 'Being struck by an enemy while below 35% health instantly resets the cooldown of your Vampiric Fang and grants you Wretched. Can only occur once per minute' at ProcChance 100. The taken-damage event and the one-minute limit are the spell_proc row (PROC_FLAG_TAKEN_DAMAGE, Cooldown 60000); the below-35% gate is an AuraScript DoCheckProc, because no spell_proc column expresses it. Vampiric Fang is cast as rank 553272, the rank a level-80 character owns per AscensionSpellProgressionData.h; every rank shares Category 513 with CategoryRecoveryTime 8000, and MiscValueB 1 makes Spell::EffectAscensionResetCooldown clear that category as well as rank 1's own entry, so the owned rank comes off cooldown too. Health is set to 60000 against a maximum near 210000, well under the 35% gate and far above anything the adds can chew through. Harness constraint: fixture creatures are forced REACT_PASSIVE twice during setup (CoAGameplayTest.cpp) and CreatureAI::UpdateVictim never selects a victim for a passive creature, so a fixture can never strike a player, and the harness has no player-versus-player combat either. The only incoming damage available is therefore from creatures the fixture itself summons, which are ordinary spawns and not subject to the fixture's forced passivity. Scholomance Dark Summoner 11582 is used for that: its SmartAI casts Summon Risen Lackey 17618 on itself 2-5 s after engaging and again every 5-7 s, the self-targeted shape the harness can drive, and the Risen Lackeys then attack normally. QA Test +10000 HP/MP 10040 at 20 stacks raises maximum health by about 200000 so nobody in this scenario can be killed by them.

steps.label: Let spawn AI and level scaling settle
Vampiric Fang is on its category cooldown
Drop the Bloodmage under the talent's 35% gate
The fixture caster is engaged and summoning
DISCRIMINATING: being struck while low grants Wretched
and Wretched's own effect 195 cleared Vampiric Fang's cooldown
